facts.text: The Temple Promise covers full-time tuition and the mandatory university services fee for eligible students whose families have an adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less.
Under the Fly in 4 partnership, Temple University guarantees students will complete their degree on time or the university will pay for the remaining coursework.

sources.title: Tuition & Financial Aid - Fox School of Business - Temple University

facts.text: The Temple Promise covers remaining undergraduate tuition and eligible fees after all other aid is applied for eligible students.
